The '''fineband scope''' was a type of [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]].

==History==
A fineband scope was used by the [[Priests of the Red Nebula|priests]] of the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] to monitor [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beams]].<ref name="SW50" /> The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with a fineband scope.<ref name="DR" />
